title: Copper Stonecutter Stripping
description: Bulk strip anything copper to save time and axe durability!
body:
Copper Stonecutter Stripping allows you to strip any variant of copper into any stripped version below your current, but wax will be stripped! If you want, you can also strip only the wax here too.
***
Supports every variant of copper, along with compatibility for [Metal Fences](https://modrinth.com/mod/metal-fences), [Vanilla Shutters](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanilla-shutters), and [Simple Copper Pipes](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-copper-pipes)!
